notes: The left side is simpler: Assignments, Completed and Archived. The week strip at the top now shows up to two weeks, and choosing a day brings that day's work forward in your list. Sybl now says plainly when it last synced, and if a sync fails it tries again half an hour later instead of the next day. Set-up goes one step at a time, Settings is calmer, and Sybl asks about finished classes once. Plus small fixes.
